title: Grand Hotel (Mackinac Island)
scope: The standing Grand Hotel on Mackinac Island, with its long south verandah, white-painted upper floors, green roof and cupola, and connected rear and end wings.
limitations: The connected hotel and its current exterior are in scope. Furnishings, grounds, independent service buildings and signage are excluded.

Porch extent follows the mapped building and its end returns. Published survey and promotional lengths use differing measurements. Dimensions of smaller windows, rear connections and roof fittings are estimates.
